description.value: Mon Paris Patisserie is an artisan French bakery and café founded by Chef Elena Krasnova, who trained at the Ferrandie Ecole de Gastronomie in Paris. The Burnaby location in the Metrotown area offers handcrafted croissants, macarons, chocolates, custom cakes, and a café menu of espresso drinks. Cyclists can stop in for freshly made pastries, croissant sandwiches, and quality coffee in a small café setting.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands at 3m; stands at 7m; stands at 16m; stands at 46m; rack (10 spaces) at 54m; stands (11 spaces, covered) at 76m; stands (10 spaces) at 90m. Total: 31 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content fully corroborates the OSM phone number (604 564 5665), address (4396 Beresford Street, Burnaby BC V5H 2Y4), and website URL. The menu page confirms hot beverages (espresso, lattes, etc.) and lunch-format croissant sandwiches, but neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any other cyclist-specific infrastructure. One discrepancy noted: OSM opening hours show closing at 17:00, while the website consistently states closing at 6pm (18:00).
concerns: OSM opening hours show closing at 17:00, but the website consistently states closing at 6pm (18:00) across all pages — OSM tag may be outdated.
OSM community field lists 'Vancouver' but the address is in Burnaby (V5H 2Y4); the business itself correctly identifies as Burnaby on its website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible French patisserie and café with confirmed website and contact details. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking pastries, coffee, and light lunch items.
